name: kaizen-bot
description: AI teammates for every division: role bots you chat with, which draft work and hold it for your approval.

scripts.build: for t in linux-x64 linux-arm64 darwin-x64 darwin-arm64 windows-x64; do bun build --compile --minify --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --target=bun-$t src/server.ts --outfile dist/kaizen-bot-$t || exit 1; done
